reason: ReDoS from a glob pattern with single-branch repeated extglobs; affects every picomatch release (<=4.0.7, the latest), no fix as of 2026-11-17. Only a malicious pattern triggers it, and none reaches picomatch here: no src/ file imports picomatch, micromatch, fast-glob, tinyglobby, fdir, vite or vitest. In production code it is reached only through @daytona/sdk -> fast-glob -> micromatch, which the SDK calls only in Image.fromDockerfile to expand a local Dockerfile's COPY sources; tavya never builds a Daytona image from a Dockerfile (src/world/environment-build.ts uses Image.base().runCommands() only). The other paths (vitest, vite, tinyglobby, fdir) do ship in the image (better-auth's optional peer vitest makes them devOptional, which npm ci --omit=dev in deploy/Dockerfile keeps), but nothing at runtime loads them: better-auth uses vitest only in its test-utils, which tavya does not import, and the test runner matches only the repository's own test globs.
